fields.title: PlayTerminal
fields.content: PlayTerminal brings old-school console games back to life. Pick a game from the list and play it right in your browser.

fields.title: About
fields.content: PlayTerminal runs terminal-based games in your browser.

fields.name: Robots
fields.info:
Robots is a classic game from the BSD games collection.

You are surrounded by robots that chase you around the board. Make them crash into each other and into the junk heaps they leave behind. Teleport when cornered.

Move with h, j, k, l, y, u, b, n. Press t to teleport, w to wait for the robots.

fields.name: Greed
fields.info: Eat as many numbers as you can without running into the edges or into eaten squares.

fields.name: Hangman
fields.info: Guess the word, one letter at a time, before the man is hanged.

fields.name: NetHack
fields.info:
NetHack is the classic roguelike, first released in 1987.

Explore the Dungeons of Doom, fight its monsters, and retrieve the Amulet of Yendor. Every game is a new dungeon, and a death is final.

Move with h, j, k, l, y, u, b, n. Press ? for help and the full list of commands, and Ctrl-C to quit.
